title: IL-6 Signaling in Chronic Inflammation and Tumor Progression
text: Interleukin-6 is a pleiotropic cytokine that plays a central role in chronic inflammation and tumor progression. Elevated IL-6 levels in the tumor microenvironment promote STAT3 activation, leading to enhanced cancer cell proliferation and immune evasion. Our results demonstrate that IL-6 blockade reduces tumor growth in murine models. These findings suggest that targeting the IL-6/STAT3 axis may represent a viable therapeutic strategy. Further research is needed to evaluate combination approaches with existing checkpoint inhibitors.
